description: This file defines notification-related services for an employee management system, including functions for creating notifications, listing notifications with RBAC checks, and marking notifications as read. It also handles push notifications via a stubbed Firebase function and references external models.

methods.name: canAccessNotifications(requester, targetUserId, isSystem = false)
methods.description: Checks if a requester has permission to access another user's notifications based on roles or system flag.

methods.name: sendPushStub({ deviceToken, title, body, data })
methods.description: Simulates sending a push notification via Firebase; in real implementation, would use Firebase Admin SDK.

methods.name: createNotification({ recipientId, title, body, data, deviceToken, createdBySystem = false })
methods.description: Creates a notification record for a user and optionally sends a push notification.

methods.name: listNotifications({ requester, userId, page = 1, pageSize = 20, unreadOnly = false, isSystem = false })
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notifications for a user, with RBAC enforcement for access control.

methods.name: markAsRead({ requester, id, isSystem = false })
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read, with access checks.
